description: This file defines a final class 'Operator' containing constants for various filter operators used in report filtering for the OrangeHRM application. It allows consistent reference to specific filtering operations (e.g., 'in', 'eq', 'lt') within the report filtering system.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: A final class containing constant definitions for report filter operators such as 'in', 'eq', 'lt', etc.
